test_tz_convert: test the Timestamp.tz_convert method converts a UTC timestamp to a target timezone
test_astimezone_alias: test that Timestamp.astimezone behaves as an alias for tz_convert
test_tz_convert_roundtrip: test converting a timestamp between UTC, a target timezone, and None preserves the original wall-clock time
test_tz_convert_utc_to_dateutil_utc: test that converting a dateutil UTC timestamp to dateutil.tz.tzutc leaves the time unchanged
test_tz_convert_with_dateutil_tzstr: test tz_convert with dateutil/US/Eastern timezone string format
